author: Danielgtnatv
quote: First of all, this isn’t "review bombing."Here we go: the game’s story is weak. You’re forced to do tedious missions just to please Lucia—washing cars, painting walls, carrying tables, running errands... It’s like a real-life simulator, hahaha—that’s definitely not why I turned on my **** what’s worse: how can a game about the criminal underworld *not* have the option to hire prostitutes, like in previous titles? This is *GTA*—a game about thugs, criminals, and outlaws—and the damn game won’t even let you cheat? Hahahaha, what a **** game also introduced an honor system, similar to *RDR2*, where you can’t kill NPCs without your honor dropping—it’s absolutely ridiculous.
